verdict.rationale: Kling documents an in-product Agent that users can brainstorm with in conversation to write scripts, generate images, videos and storyboards, and then refine edits over multiple rounds (kling-docs-3). This is backed by text-prompt generation (kling-docs-16, kling-docs-21) and an MCP/CLI path that lets external AI agents drive Kling (kling-docs-8). missing for 10: detailed documentation of which product operations the Agent can perform via natural-language commands, independent or hands-on corroboration that the conversational control works as claimed.
